original.target_description: Study 1, treatment preference ratings; speaker L1 main-effect coefficient; Calgary listeners rating L1 English versus L1 Tagalog speakers; binomial generalized linear mixed-effects model with logit link.

n.sample_role: analytic rating observations (repeated ratings nested within listeners and speakers)
n.exclusions: Row-wise deletion of missing predictor or response values; initial 576 observations from 96 listeners.
n.quote: In the end, there were 551 observations for the rating of competence, 556 observations for the rating of treatment preference, and 564 observations for the rating of comprehensibility.

es.metric: Estimate (binomial mixed-effects model logit coefficient; standardization not stated)

replication.target_description: Study 1, treatment preference ratings; speaker L1 main-effect coefficient; Santa Catarina L1 Brazilian Portuguese listeners rating L1 BP versus L1 Spanish speakers (conceptual replication of the English/Tagalog contrast); binomial generalized linear mixed-effects model with logit link.

n.sample_role: analytic rating observations (repeated ratings nested within listeners and speakers)
n.exclusions: Row-wise deletion of missing values from 360 observations; 60 listeners. Two listeners reporting hearing issues retained because exclusion did not change findings.
n.location: Data analysis, paragraph immediately preceding Results (p. 6)
n.quote: Despite having 360 observations for each response variable, the lme4 function used row-wise deletion to handle missing values. In the end, there were 351 observations for each rating.

es.metric: Estimate (binomial mixed-effects model logit coefficient; standardization not stated)

reported_success.location: Discussion, Competence and treatment preference, p. 13
reported_success.quote: Regarding listener treatment preference specifically, these ratings showed a more straightforward effect of speaker L1, with L2 BP speakers generally receiving higher preference ratings than L1 BP speakers, which is strikingly different from the results of the initial study.

notes: Original primary author-hosted PDF title and DOI verified; acquired from https://www.paveltrofimovich.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Telo_et_al_2022.pdf.
